roadmap.title: Opening story and Vernworth
roadmap.description: Play the early story, then pick up the quick firsts: vocation change, camping, oxcart, Ferrystone, pawn quest and the Rose Chateau.

roadmap.title: Midgame story and side quests
roadmap.description: Advance the main story through the border, unlock vocations and a house, and clear the easy world achievements and side quests.

roadmap.title: Collections and challenge cleanup
roadmap.description: Do the long cleanup before the point of no return: riddles, maister teachings, tokens, caves, affection, Medusa, meats, ranks and the horseman.

roadmap.title: Preparation before the point of no return
roadmap.description: Make a backup save, switch to Archer with an Unmaking Arrow for the Gigantus, finish the Eternal Wakestone miracle, and unlock Mystic Spearhand.

roadmap.title: Endings and the Unmoored World
roadmap.description: Play Main Quests 15 and 16, take the Peace ending, then return in time to the dragon and complete the Unmoored World achievements.

roadmap.title: Dark Arisen expansion
roadmap.description: With the expansion owned, start the Norgan story and the Lost Rites trials for the six expansion achievements.

achievements.summary: Finish the prologue by escaping slavery.

steps.text: Play through the prologue until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Regained your memories of receiving the Arisen's charge.
achievements.summary: Recover the Arisen’s memory of being given their charge.

steps.text: Keep playing @mechanic{Main Quest 3, In Dragon’s Wake} until it unlocks.

achievements.summary: Arrive in Vernworth.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Vernworth} as part of @mechanic{Main Quest 3, In Dragon’s Wake}.

achievements.description: Passed through the gate at the border.
achievements.summary: Pass through the border gate at Checkpoint Rest Town.

steps.text: Go to the gate in @loc{Checkpoint Rest Town} as part of @mechanic{Main Quest 11, Nation of the Lambent Flame}.
If you are human, buy a @item{Beastren Mask} at @npc{Ibrahim}’s Scrap Store first.
steps.note: Show @npc{Captain Brant}’s permit, which you receive at the start of the quest, to the guard.

steps.text: Walk through the gate.

achievements.summary: Enter the Unmoored World by using the Empowered Godsbane Blade on yourself during the dragon ride.

guide.context: The blade is a story item from the previous main quest. Using it starts the secret ending path, which holds several later achievements.

steps.text: Strike the huge dragon at the end of @mechanic{Main Quest 16, Legacy} so you begin riding it.
Climb up to the orange heart where its neck meets its body.
Use @item{Empowered Godsbane Blade} from your inventory and aim it at yourself.

achievements.summary: Become Sovran of Vernworth by finishing the dragon ride ending.

guide.context: After this, choose Load from Last Save (not New Game+). Talk to the glowing blue man left of the throne twice to travel back to the dragon ride. That path leads to the Unmoored World achievements.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Main Quest 16, Legacy}, ride the dragon to the end and do not attack its heart.
Defeat the dragon in the fight that follows.
In the throne room, sit on the throne and stay seated until the credits end.

achievements.summary: Help the gigantus walk again by watching its trial in the Unmoored World.

guide.context: This trial is one of the four trials of The Hero, so you can earn it in the same run.

steps.text: Go to the kneeling gigantus on @loc{Agamen Volcanic Island}.
Interact with it and watch the fight.

achievements.description: Experienced the end of the cycle. (Not available in Casual Mode)
achievements.summary: Reach the end of the cycle by finishing the Unmoored World ending.

guide.context: Casual Mode blocks this achievement. The game ends when you touch the red beacon.

steps.text: Finish the achievement The Guardian first so people are safe.
At the @loc{Seafloor Shrine}, interact with the red beacon.
During the credits, stand on the dragon’s ridges when it breathes fire on itself.
steps.note: Standing on the ridges stops you from burning to death.

achievements.summary: Change your vocation at an inn or guild hall.

steps.text: Pay 100 DEP to change your vocation, first at the @loc{Melve} inn, where a story objective shows you how.

achievements.description: Changed your vocation to mystic spearhand.
achievements.summary: Change your vocation to Mystic Spearhand.

guide.context: You can also unlock it earlier by talking to @npc{Sigurd}, who stands at dragon sites such as @loc{Dragonsbreath Tower}.

steps.text: It unlocks once you take on the dragons for the story quest @mechanic{Main Quest 14, A New Godsway}.
Change to it at a guild hall such as the one in @loc{Vernworth} or @loc{Bakbattahl}.

achievements.summary: Change your vocation to Trickster.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Main Quest 12, Flickering Shadows}, talk to the Dragonforged and the Oracle to unlock the vocation.
Change to it at a guild hall such as the one in @loc{Vernworth} or @loc{Bakbattahl}.

achievements.description: Changed your vocation to magick archer.
achievements.summary: Change your vocation to Magick Archer.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Put a Spring in Thy Step} to unlock the vocation.
Change to it at a guild hall such as the one in @loc{Vernworth} or @loc{Bakbattahl}.

achievements.displayName: Jack of All Trades, Master of...All Trades
achievements.summary: Change your vocation to Warfarer.

steps.text: Finish the side quest @mechanic{The Sotted Sage} to unlock the vocation.
Change to it at a guild hall such as the one in @loc{Vernworth} or @loc{Bakbattahl}.

achievements.summary: Go camping at a campsite with a camping kit.

guide.context: Merchants in major towns also sell camping kits, and campfire spots line the main roads.

steps.text: Follow the trail leading east out of the @loc{Borderland Campground}, northeast of @loc{Melve}.
Pick up the camping kit next to the campsite and interact with the campsite.

achievements.description: Purchased a dwelling of your own.
achievements.summary: Buy a house of your own.

guide.context: A second option is a 30,000 gold house in @loc{Bakbattahl}, sold by a woman in the north of the city.

steps.text: Start the quest @mechanic{A Place to Call Home} by talking to the girl on the road south of the @loc{Stardrop Inn} in @loc{Vernworth}. Rest on a bench if she is not there.
Visit her house and sleep there for 7 days.
Buy the house for 20,000 gold when she offers it.

achievements.summary: Board an oxcart.

steps.text: At an oxcart station, such as the one at the northwest exit of @loc{Vernworth}, interact with the sign and choose Await Oxcart.
Climb on the cart, pay the 100 to 200 gold fare, and sit on the bench.

achievements.description: Used a Wakestone to restore the dead to life.
achievements.summary: Revive a dead person with a Wakestone.

guide.context: Three @item{Wakestone Shards} combine into one Wakestone.

steps.text: Collect a @item{Wakestone} as a story reward in @mechanic{Main Quest 6, Disa’s Plot} or @mechanic{Main Quest 8, The Stolen Throne}.
Kill a villager in @loc{Vernworth}, then revive that person with the Wakestone.

achievements.summary: Use a Ferrystone to travel to a Portcrystal.

guide.context: Ferrystones do not work indoors.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Ferrystone} at a general store, such as Philbert’s Sundries in @loc{Vernworth}.
Discover a Portcrystal, for example the one behind the Grand Riftstone in @loc{Vernworth}.
Go outside, open your inventory, use the Ferrystone, and pick the Portcrystal.

achievements.summary: Earn a pawn badge by defeating many of one kind of enemy.

guide.context: You can check badge progress under Options, Status, then the Pawn menu.

steps.text: Kill about 30 @enemy{Cyclops} until a badge appears in the Pawn menu.
To respawn large enemies, rest 7 or more days straight.
steps.note: Two Cyclops stand on the wall of the castle in northern @loc{Ancient Battleground}.

achievements.description: Defeated the gigantus in a short span of time.
achievements.summary: Defeat the gigantus quickly with an Unmaking Arrow.

guide.context: Dragons drop @item{Wyrmslife Crystals}.

steps.text: Before @mechanic{Main Quest 14, A New Godsway} ends, switch to the Archer vocation and equip a bow.
steps.note: Make a backup save first. The arrow can be used only once, and the game saves when you fire it.

steps.text: Pay 8 @item{Wyrmslife Crystals} to the Dragonborne in the @loc{Bay Wayside Shrine} cave, north of @loc{Bakbattahl}, for an @item{Unmaking Arrow}.
When @mechanic{Main Quest 15, The Guardian Gigantus} begins, pass the sealed gate in southern @loc{Bakbattahl}.
When the gigantus rises from the sea, run downhill and shoot its upper body with the arrow while it is still in the water.
Wait about 6 minutes for it to collapse.

achievements.description: Found a solution to every conundrum posed by the goddess of riddles.
achievements.summary: Solve all ten of the Sphinx’s riddles.

guide.context: You get one try per riddle. A wrong answer locks this achievement for the run. Play as an Archer. The riddles at the second shrine come in a random order, so do each one in the order the Sphinx gives it.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Eyes
collectibles.method: Take the @item{Sealing Phial} from the chest above the entrance and give it to the Sphinx. Do not drink it.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Madness
collectibles.method: Carry your main pawn onto the platform in front of her, then answer.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Wisdom
collectibles.method: Hire the pawn named SphinxParent, SphinxFather or SphinxMother and put it on the platform. It stands in the Riftstone of Fellowship rift or the Harve Village rift.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Conviction
collectibles.method: Give her any item. Every answer is correct.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Rumination
collectibles.location: Where you found your first Seeker’s Token
collectibles.method: Within 7 days, go to that spot and pick up the Finder’s Token, then give it to the Sphinx.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Reunion
collectibles.method: Find the Sphinx at the new site and open the first chest. This counts as solved. Reach it by the river west under @loc{Checkpoint Rest Town}.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Futility
collectibles.method: Keep the vase from breaking. Easiest is to carry old @npc{Maurits} from the Mural Byway in @loc{Bakbattahl} to the vase with a Ferrystone.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Differentiation
collectibles.method: Bring the man shown in the Sphinx’s vision: Dante has straight hair and Vergil has curly hair. Both walk in @loc{Checkpoint Rest Town}.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Recollection
collectibles.method: Put as many statues in front of her as riddles you have solved correctly so far, counting Reunion.

collectibles.name: Riddle of Contest
collectibles.method: Grab the opponent that appears and throw it off the cliff on the right.

achievements.summary: Cut off a medusa’s head.

guide.context: Doing this while she is near full health also gives the Preserved Medusa Head, which is needed for An Eye for an Eye.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Medusa} in @loc{Calignious Depths}, south of @loc{Bakbattahl}.
Climb to her head and use normal melee attacks until it falls off.

achievements.summary: Learn all twelve maister teachings.

guide.context: Each teaching must be learned by using its tome. You do not need the matching vocation active, but you need to have unlocked it. You can collect them in any order.

collectibles.name: Fighter
collectibles.method: Raise his affinity to the maximum with a @item{Wyrmslife Crystal}, sleep, and a second crystal. He gives the Soldier’s Code tome.

collectibles.name: Thief, first teaching
collectibles.location: @npc{Flaude}, Old Noble Manor in the Nameless Village
collectibles.method: Talk to him about the village and about you. If he does not give the Legend’s Opus, give him gifts over several days.

collectibles.name: Thief, second teaching
collectibles.location: Nameless Village Depths, end of the cave
collectibles.method: Take the ladder at the last house left of the big manor. Talk to the man at the end for the Pilferer’s Handbook.

collectibles.name: Archer
collectibles.method: Bring a pawn that has the Woodland Wordsmith specialization so you can understand him, and max his affinity for the Hunter’s Secret tome.

collectibles.name: Warrior
collectibles.location: @npc{Beren}, his childhood home south of @loc{Checkpoint Rest Town}
collectibles.method: Complete @mechanic{Claw Them Into Shape}, then @mechanic{Beren’s Final Lesson}. Talk to him for the Champion’s Fable.

collectibles.name: Mage
collectibles.method: Hand her 3 of the 6 genuine books to complete @mechanic{Spellbound}. Talk to her again at once for the Conjurer’s Jottings.

collectibles.name: Sorcerer, first teaching
collectibles.method: After Spellbound, talk to her for the Enchanter’s Almanac.

collectibles.name: Sorcerer, second teaching
collectibles.method: Give the quest giver the other 3 real books. Forgeries from Ibrahim’s Scrap Store also work.

collectibles.name: Trickster
collectibles.method: Talk to her downstairs to unlock the vocation, climb the ladder to the roof, and talk to her again for the Theurgist’s Rite.

collectibles.name: Mystic Spearhand
collectibles.method: Raise his affinity to the maximum with gifts. If he refuses gifts, beat the dragon there with him first. He gives the Paladin’s Enigmata.

collectibles.name: Magick Archer
collectibles.method: Finish @mechanic{Put a Spring in Thy Step}, then talk to her for the Spellbow’s Paradox.

collectibles.name: Warfarer
collectibles.method: Finish @mechanic{The Sotted Sage}, then talk to him for the Grandmaster’s Path.

achievements.description: Reached the maximum rank in a vocation.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum rank in one vocation.

steps.text: Play as one vocation and defeat enemies to earn DEP until you reach rank 9.

achievements.summary: Teach your pawn a specialization.

guide.context: The Chirurgeon’s Tome comes from @npc{Flora} after the side quest @mechanic{Medicament Predicament}. The Logistician’s Tome comes from @npc{Kendrick} in the @loc{Vernworth} slums.

steps.text: Get one blue Specialization Tome, for example the Forager’s Tome from @npc{Irena} in @loc{Vernworth}.
To get it, give Irena a @item{Wyrmslife Crystal}, sleep, then give her another.
Walk outside her house; she gives you the tome.

achievements.summary: Set a pawn quest at a Grand Riftstone.

guide.context: If the option is grayed out, rest one time at an inn or in a bed you own while your main pawn is alive.

steps.text: At the Grand Riftstone in @loc{Vernworth} or @loc{Bakbattahl}, enter the Riftworld.
Interact with the Riftstone again and choose Set a Pawn Quest.

achievements.summary: Enter the Rose Chateau.

steps.text: In the Noble Quarter in the south of @loc{Vernworth}, go to the building farthest south, the Rose Chateau Bordelrie.
Go through the door.

achievements.summary: Collect 80 Seeker’s Tokens.

guide.context: Only tokens you find in your own game count. A duplicated token does not.

steps.text: Find and pick up Seeker’s Tokens across the world until you have found 80 of the 240.
Note where you find your first token.
steps.note: You need that spot for a Sphinx riddle.

achievements.summary: Raise 50 people to maximum affection.

guide.context: A person at maximum affection has red cheeks. Finishing quests also raises affection.

steps.text: Give a @item{Wyrmslife Crystal} to a person who takes gifts, sleep 24 hours, then give another to the same person.
At inns, wait for night, use Buy a Round for everyone, and rest 24 hours.
Repeat in each town until the counter reaches 50.

achievements.description: Raised a person's affinity to the maximum.
achievements.summary: Raise one person’s affinity to the maximum.

guide.context: Guards usually do not take gifts.

steps.text: Give a person a @item{Wyrmslife Crystal}, sleep 24 hours, and give them a second one.
Stop when their cheeks turn red.

achievements.summary: Strengthen a weapon in wyrmfire.

guide.context: Dragons drop @item{Wyrmslife Crystals}.

steps.text: Buy the three normal upgrades for the weapon at any weapon vendor.
Take the weapon to the Dragonforged at the @loc{Bay Wayside Shrine} cave, north of @loc{Bakbattahl}.
Pay @item{Wyrmslife Crystals} for the fourth upgrade.

achievements.description: Led the people to safety in the unmoored world.
achievements.summary: Lead the people of the Unmoored World to safety.

guide.context: The achievement can unlock after these three evacuations. Do not touch the red beacon, which ends the game.

steps.text: Finish The Hero first, in the same life.
steps.note: Dying in the Unmoored World sends you back to its start and wipes your progress there.

steps.text: At the @loc{Seafloor Shrine}, talk to @npc{Rothias} inside the blue beacon glow, not the red one. @npc{Luz} then asks you to evacuate people.
Evacuate @loc{Vernworth}: talk to @npc{Brant} at the inn, then @npc{Sven} at the castle.
Evacuate @loc{Sacred Arbor}: talk to @npc{Glyndwr}, then convince his father @npc{Taliesin}. A pawn that has the Woodland Wordsmith specialization lets you understand him.
Evacuate @loc{Bakbattahl}: talk to @npc{Menella} at the palace and end three fights.

achievements.description: Overcame all the trials of the unmoored world.
achievements.summary: Overcome all four trials of the Unmoored World.

steps.text: Complete all four trials within four days. Each land is destroyed one by one if you are slow.
steps.note: Dying resets your progress there, so finish in one life.

steps.text: Get your main pawn back through the quest @mechanic{Dreams Apart} in the Forbidden Magick Research Lab in @loc{Bakbattahl}.
Trial 1: go to the red dot left of @loc{Vernworth} and beat the boss. Bring Wakestones and be above level 30.
Trial 2: go to @loc{Sacred Arbor} and beat the worm boss by attacking its weak points from tail to head.
Trial 3: go to the kneeling gigantus on @loc{Agamen Volcanic Island} and watch the fight.
Trial 4: go to @loc{Bakbattahl}, follow @npc{Phaestus}, and slay the dragon.

achievements.summary: Soak in the hot spring at Geyser Hamlet.

steps.text: Take the southwest road from @loc{Bakbattahl} through @loc{Drabnir’s Grotto} to the @loc{Volcanic Island Camp}.
Climb to the top area, talk to the man in front of the Geyser Hamlet marker, and pay 100 gold.

achievements.summary: Cross a bridge made by a cyclops hanging from a ledge.

guide.context: Go without pawns so they do not pull its attention away. A Mage can fly over the ledge at vocation rank 2.

steps.text: Lead a @enemy{Cyclops} to a ledge, for example east of @loc{Vernworth}, so it falls and grabs the far edge.
Run across its body.

achievements.description: Summoned a harpy, grabbed hold, and took flight.
achievements.summary: Summon a harpy, grab it, and fly.

steps.text: Get a @item{Harpysnare Smoke Beacon} from a traveling merchant or the chest in @loc{Twilight Cave}, east of @loc{Vernworth}.
Use it in the open, then jump and grab the harpy when it arrives.

achievements.summary: Revive two downed pawns at once.

steps.text: When two pawns are downed close together, hold the revive button next to them.

achievements.summary: Buy the sword Dragon’s Dogma.

guide.context: The Peace ending gives 100 @item{Wyrmslife Crystals}.

steps.text: Get 110 @item{Wyrmslife Crystals}.
Buy the sword from the Dragonforged: at the @loc{Seafloor Shrine} in the Unmoored World, or in New Game+ at the @loc{Bay Wayside Shrine} north of @loc{Bakbattahl}.

achievements.summary: Turn a medusa to stone with a preserved medusa head.

guide.context: The head decays over time. Items in storage do not decay.

steps.text: Cut off a medusa’s head while she is near full health to get a @item{Preserved Medusa Head}. Do the fight as in Off with Its Head!
Put the head into storage at the Pilgrim’s Inn in @loc{Bakbattahl} right away.
Rest 14 days on the bench outside the inn to respawn her.
Take the head out and go straight back to her lair without resting.
Equip the head, open your inventory again, choose Brandish, and aim at her.

achievements.summary: Get a preserved medusa head.

guide.context: If she took too much damage you only get a normal head. Rest 14 days to respawn her and try again.

steps.text: Cut off a medusa’s head while she is near full health, as in Off with Its Head!, and pick it up.

achievements.description: Grilled every type of meat during the night and day.
achievements.summary: Grill each of the eight kinds of meat during the day and at night.

guide.context: You need a camping kit and a campfire. Pick the meat at the campfire before you sleep. Sleeping switches between day and night. Grill all eight by day first, then one at night. If it has not unlocked, grill the other seven at night too.

collectibles.name: Scrag of Beast
collectibles.method: Grill it at a campfire.

collectibles.name: Aged Scrag of Beast
collectibles.location: Keep a Scrag of Beast in your inventory for about a day
collectibles.method: Grill it at a campfire.

collectibles.name: Rotten Scrag of Beast
collectibles.location: Dropped by rats, or let a Scrag of Beast rot for several days
collectibles.method: Grill it at a campfire.

collectibles.name: Dried Meat
collectibles.location: Quest rewards, or combine 2 Aged Scrag of Beast
collectibles.method: Grill it at a campfire.

collectibles.name: Exquisite Dried Meat
collectibles.method: Grill it at a campfire.

collectibles.name: Beast-Steak
collectibles.location: Dropped by big wolverines west of @loc{Vernworth}, boars and deer
collectibles.method: Grill it at a campfire.

collectibles.name: Aged Beast-Steak
collectibles.location: Keep a Beast-Steak in your inventory for about a day
collectibles.method: Grill it at a campfire.

collectibles.name: Rotten Beast-Steak
collectibles.location: Let a Beast-Steak rot for several days
collectibles.method: Grill it at a campfire.

achievements.description: Attended a palace masquerade in formal raiment.
achievements.summary: Attend a masquerade in formal clothing.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Main Quest 8, The Stolen Throne}, talk to @npc{Captain Brant} at the @loc{Stardrop Inn} at night and choose “Tell me of the masquerade.”
Take the Courtly Tunic and Courtly Breeches from the Comptroller’s Home in the Noble Quarter of @loc{Vernworth}. Wear both and remove other armor and helmets.
At night, go into Vernworth Hall in the castle. If no masquerade is held, wait until the next night.

achievements.description: Restored the dead to life at a morgue or charnel house.
achievements.summary: Revive a dead person at a morgue.

steps.text: Kill any villager and rest at least a day.
Take the body to the charnel house in @loc{Vernworth} or the morgue in @loc{Bakbattahl}. Pay the attendant to light a candle over that coffin.
Use a @item{Wakestone} from your own inventory on the coffin.

achievements.description: Accomplished a miracle for several people all at once.
achievements.summary: Revive several people at once with the Eternal Wakestone.

guide.context: Regular Wakestones revive one person. The Eternal Wakestone revives everyone nearby.

steps.text: Make a backup save. Then beat the Sphinx in A Game of Wits as an Archer, shooting an Unmaking Arrow into her beast body, not her face.
steps.note: She drops a key. Open the big gold chest behind her to get the @item{Eternal Wakestone}.

steps.text: Kill two or more people in @loc{Vernworth} or @loc{Bakbattahl} and carry them into the morgue.
Go outside and use the @item{Eternal Wakestone}.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Headless Horseman.

guide.context: He has four health bars. Level 30 or higher helps.

steps.text: Travel at night until the glowing blue @enemy{Headless Horseman} appears, or begin the quest @mechanic{Till Death Do Us Part} in @loc{Vernworth}, which makes him fight you.
Defeat him before the night ends, or he runs away.

achievements.summary: Discover 50 caves.

guide.context: Only caves count, not other points of interest.

steps.text: Enter 50 different caves and leave again until the counter reaches 50.

achievements.summary: Board the phantom oxcart.

steps.text: Take the side quest @mechanic{The Phantom Oxcart} until you discover the phantom oxcart.
Unequip all weapons and armor.
Talk to the driver and get into the back of the cart.

achievements.description: Took flight on griffin wing a second time.
achievements.summary: Ride a griffin as it flies away a second time.

guide.context: The griffin must fly to a different place. A short hop in the same fight does not count.

steps.text: Fight a @enemy{Griffin}, for example one west of @loc{Bakbattahl}, but do not kill it.
When it tries to fly away, climb onto it and hold on until it lands elsewhere.

achievements.summary: Return to Agamen Volcanic Island.

steps.text: Open the sealed door in southeastern @loc{Bakbattahl} during @mechanic{Main Quest 15, The Guardian Gigantus}.

achievements.description: Witnessed a brawl break out in your dwelling among your admirers.
achievements.summary: Make two admirers brawl in your house.

guide.context: Avoid merchants and guards, who stay in set places. If they do not fight, max a third person and bring all three.

steps.text: Own a house by finishing @mechanic{A Place to Call Home}.
Give two @item{Wyrmslife Crystals}, with a sleep between them, to each of two people who accept gifts, until their cheeks turn red.
Lead both to your house and wait for them to fight.

achievements.summary: Reach Dragonsbreath Tower.

steps.text: Walk up the steep hill southwest of @loc{Bakbattahl} to @loc{Dragonsbreath Tower}.

achievements.summary: Reach Drabnir’s Grotto.

steps.text: Follow the road southwest of @loc{Bakbattahl} and enter @loc{Drabnir’s Grotto}.

achievements.displayName: To the Victor Go the Spoils
achievements.description: Reclaimed your items from the scavenger who stole them from you.
achievements.summary: Kill the scavenger that stole your items.

guide.context: Dismiss your hired pawns and throw your main pawn off a cliff if they kill the enemies too quickly.

steps.text: Take the path north from @loc{Checkpoint Rest Town} and turn right at the first fork to the cave with harpies and scavengers.
Let a harpy put you to sleep so a @enemy{Scavenger} steals your items.
Kill that scavenger.

achievements.description: Used illicit means to pass through the gate at the border.
achievements.summary: Pass through the border gate in a royal carriage without a permit.

guide.context: The carriage has an enclosed back and a roof. A mask or the river path does not count. It passes the gate in the afternoon.

steps.text: Put the @item{Beastren Border Entry Permit} and @item{Battahl Residence Permit} in storage.
Go to the oxcart station by the entrance of @loc{Checkpoint Rest Town}. Interact with its sign, not the bench, and choose Await Oxcart. Then rest one time on the bench opposite.
When the royal carriage appears on the road outside town, get in and ride through the gate.

achievements.summary: Arrive in Norgan.

guide.context: This needs the Dark Arisen expansion. It cannot be started once you have entered the Unmoored World, so use New Game+ in that case. Level 40 is recommended.

steps.text: Find @npc{Captain Brant} at night inside the @loc{Stardrop Inn} in @loc{Vernworth}. Pick the dialogue option “About the new Arisen…” to start the Norgan story.
Follow @mechanic{Chilling Tidings} until the giant bird takes you to Norgan.

achievements.description: Reached the end of the Final Proving Ground without recovering your loss gauge.
achievements.summary: Finish the Final Proving Ground trial without ever restoring your loss gauge.

guide.context: Both earlier trials need the Empowered Godsbane Blade. The Lost Rites questline starts with @npc{Captain Brant}.

steps.text: Clear the Lost Rites trials Molten Gauntlet and Seafloor Sepulcher in the Unmoored World.
Enter the Final Proving Ground and do not restore your lost maximum health at any point.
Reach the end of the trial.

achievements.description: Heeded the request of Norgan's guardian.
achievements.summary: Follow the request of Norgan’s guardian.

steps.text: Continue the Norgan story and carry out the guardian’s request when it is given.

achievements.description: Broke through five vile eye barriers at once.
achievements.summary: Break five vile eye barriers at once.

steps.text: Clear four Lost Rites trials, then enter @loc{Mired Conduit} in Coral Snakes’ Hideout in @loc{Battahl}, the earliest trial with an Evil Eye.
Break five vile eye barriers in a single action.

achievements.summary: Grant Eir’s wish.

steps.text: Follow the Norgan story to its end and choose to spare the corpse in @mechanic{The Castle in the Ice}, so the story reunites @npc{Eir} and Rovall.

achievements.description: Reclaimed stolen items from the snowfoot's den.
achievements.summary: Retrieve the goods the snowfoot took from its den.

steps.text: Take the side quest @mechanic{The Snatching-Beast} from @npc{Wash} at the Mountain Stronghold after @mechanic{Rumbles in the North}.
Go to the lair east of the stronghold from the north side and kill the @enemy{Snowfoot}.
Find all five Commission Supplies in the lair and leave them unopened.
Deliver the sealed supplies to @npc{Wash} at Northwall Campground.
